final_result_messages.result:
The checks gate repair is pushed to `main` as `15fd171` (on top of `320a07f`). All seven verification commands pass on that tree. I didn't wait for or watch CI on it, so the green gate and QA still have to confirm it.

**What was failing on main.** The last green run was c38f72a. I read the first page of GitHub Actions history (50 of 364 runs, so older history is unread). I couldn't read the CI logs themselves (they return 403 without a token), so I reproduced each failure locally instead.

- **Footer probe, 999fea4..7041d7f:** the probe pressed Tab a fixed 13 times, which stopped short once the Desk added a seventh page. 2a58479 had already fixed this, and that Tab check passes now.
- **Footer probe, 2a58479:** one run failed and I couldn't reproduce it, on the Mac or in a 4-CPU Ubuntu container. Still unexplained.
- **Footer walk and probe at 5cd6ee0:** the new Ryugu waterline broke two assumptions (exactly 3 SVGs, and Back to top as the footer's last stop). 3351f78 (pm-249/t-1568) fixed this while I was working, so I dropped my duplicate fix when rebasing.
- **E2E, 76141f1..8b49935:** fixed here. The E2E runner ran its test files side by side, so the tests that count animation frames (desk leaves, Ryugu sea) starved each other. `scripts/e2e.mjs` now runs them one at a time; you can still pass a different `--test-concurrency` to override it. A new test, `lib/e2e-runner.test.ts`, fails if that one-at-a-time setting is removed.

**Two new failures from the Kame companion (dd21add), also fixed here.** Both failed every time I ran them.
- The footer probe's "at most 1 pending animation frame" check was catching Kame's own frame, triggered by a late scroll event. The probe now waits for scrolling to stop before measuring, and a new negative control overlaps the two frames on purpose to show the check still catches it.
- The ink-press E2E looked up "the" status message, which became ambiguous once Kame added its own. That lookup now only searches inside the press.

**Isolated database.** The footer walk and probe now start a throwaway Postgres when no database answers and Docker isn't available (`node scripts/e2e.mjs --serve-db`), and they clean up only their own process and files. The probe passed with Docker hidden. Along the way I found that the embedded-postgres package exits on Ctrl-C/SIGTERM before our cleanup runs, which left temp files and the server behind. `e2e.mjs` now handles those signals itself.

**Results on the pushed tree:**

| Check | Result |
| --- | --- |
| `npm test` | 2078/2078 |
| lint | 0 errors |
| typecheck | pass |
| build | pass |
| footer walk | 67 ok, 0 failed |
| footer Chromium probe | 171 ok, 0 failed |
| E2E | 91/91 |

**Still open, not mine to fix (reported, not filtered):** `e2e/ryugu.test.ts:110` sometimes records an uncaught browser error after typing "urashima": "Transition was aborted because of invalid state. Page already revealed". It hit about 9 in 40 tries starting from /work, and 1 in 3 full E2E runs in the container. No page script I tried could catch it. It comes from pm-256/t-1559 and may still turn a CI run red.

The decisions and one lesson are recorded on the board, and the summary report is submitted. `commits.txt` is in `shared/artifacts`, and the full write-up is `projects/pick-up-this-plan-https-apps-vietky-io-vn-plans-plans-pm-242/t-1564-summary.md`.
